author: Henry Daniel Mosquera
name: SdkmanRun
description: Run sdk commands, or any command with SDKMAN loaded, in your pipeline
helpMarkDown: In `sdk` mode every line is an `sdk` command (`list java`, `current`, `flush`, `home java 21.0.5-tem`), passed as arguments with no shell interpolation. In `shell` mode every line is a shell command run with SDKMAN loaded.

inputs.name: commands
inputs.label: Commands
inputs.helpMarkDown: One per line. In `sdk` mode the `sdk` prefix is optional: `list java` or `sdk list java`. Each line runs on its own (in `shell` mode multi-line constructs such as `if ... fi` are not supported: use a script step). `#` lines are ignored.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: Mode

options.shell: shell - run commands with SDKMAN loaded

inputs.helpMarkDown: `sdk`: arguments are passed to `sdk` safely. `shell`: each line is interpreted by bash, so only use trusted values in it (for example, never put untrusted pipeline variables there).

inputs.name: env
inputs.label: Environment variables
inputs.helpMarkDown: `KEY=VALUE` per line, set for the commands.

inputs.name: failOnError
inputs.label: Fail on error
inputs.helpMarkDown: Stops at the first command that fails and fails the task. When off, every command runs and failures end the task with warnings.

inputs.name: autoInstallSdkman
inputs.label: Install SDKMAN if missing
inputs.helpMarkDown: Installs SDKMAN when it is not on the agent. When off, the task fails if SDKMAN is missing (use SdkmanSetup first).

inputs.name: sdkmanDir
inputs.label: SDKMAN directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where SDKMAN lives (`SDKMAN_DIR`). Empty = the `SDKMAN_DIR` already set by an earlier step, an existing `~/.sdkman`, or `<Agent.ToolsDirectory>/sdkman`.

inputs.name: installUrl
inputs.label: Installer URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Official installer, or an internal mirror for agents without internet access. Keep `rcupdate=false` so the agent's `~/.bashrc` is not modified.

inputs.name: candidatesApi
inputs.label: Candidates API
inputs.helpMarkDown: Overrides `SDKMAN_CANDIDATES_API` (default `https://api.sdkman.io/2`), for a mirror of the SDKMAN API.

inputs.name: bashPath
inputs.label: bash path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to a bash 4+ executable. Empty = auto-detect (Homebrew bash on macOS, Git Bash on Windows).

inputs.name: offline
inputs.label: Offline mode
inputs.helpMarkDown: No network access: only versions already on disk are used (restore `SDKMAN_DIR` from a pipeline cache), every candidate needs an explicit version and SDKMAN is never installed.

inputs.name: connectTimeout
inputs.label: Connect timeout (seconds)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Sets `sdkman_curl_connect_timeout` in SDKMAN's `etc/config` while the task runs (restored afterwards). Empty = SDKMAN's own value.

inputs.name: maxTime
inputs.label: Max time per request (seconds)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Sets `sdkman_curl_max_time` in SDKMAN's `etc/config` while the task runs (restored afterwards). Raise it for slow mirrors or proxies.

inputs.name: insecureSsl
inputs.label: Skip TLS verification (insecure)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Sets `sdkman_insecure_ssl=true` while the task runs, so SDKMAN's curl does not verify certificates. Only for proxies that re-sign TLS; it affects `sdk` commands, not the initial installer download.

outputVariables.name: exitCode
outputVariables.description: 0 if every command succeeded, otherwise the exit code of the first failing command
